startMessage.line1: If you lived as a fairy-tale hero, who would you be?
startMessage.line2: Someone who shines through waiting, someone who flies free, someone brave enough to love. Fairy-tale heroes each love in their own way. The story that pulls you in holds the texture of how you love.
startMessage.line3: Pick the reaction that feels most like you across twelve scenes. We'll show your fairy-tale hero and dating style—and read every result as a strength.
